scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
Applicant's fishing canoe must be registered with the Department of Captain of Ports, Government of Goa.
The scheme is applicable only for fishing canoes below 26 feet in length.
Only one outboard motor can be availed under the scheme every 5 years.
benefits_summary: General category receives a 50% subsidy up to ₹30,000; SC/ST/Woman category receives a 60% subsidy up to ₹36,000 on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
